notes: All links resolved from CardDef prefab PPtrs, component ownership, FSM serialized parameter indices; no name matching.
Event classifications are stage labels; original entry_events and transitions remain authoritative.
precast only labels Start subspell Birth, not a proven mapping to user drag; cancel is Cancel. Do not flatten into accepted cast.
hit on Impact subprefab Death is projectile arrival, not entity death.
Disabled rows and disabled SuperSpell stages must not play.
FSM AudioPlayClipAction often overrides an empty source SoundDef; use sound_def_ref.

timing_notes: Use the matching original entry_event, not all alternatives. A later external state event can interrupt a pending path.
RandomWait shared_draw_id must be sampled once per spell instance/state entry and reused by sibling layers.
Explicit FINISHED event transitions immediately; it does not wait for the longest parallel action.
Cumulative timing is relative to the subspell state event. SuperSpell spawn, projectile path and metadata iteration remain separate.
Unity frame scheduling may add up to a frame per state/action step; serialized values are not wall-clock guarantees.
Legacy animation durations are curve-bounds reconstruction, not measured Unity AnimationClip.length. Prefer the matching original animation-completion callback where available.
